park: Your typical park involving your typical daydream. Blankets, hacky, soft trades. Food and beer move easy here.
venue: Feels like you've been here before. Box office tension. Tickets if you have cash. Security eye contact.
hotel: Hot showers and a cold fridge — book a room and reset the whole crew.
friends_house: Better than good friends in high places - you have high friends in good places. Couch courtesy. Maybe a crash pad and a little stash help.
diner: Sticky menus, bottomless coffee, a waitress who's seen everything. Cheap food, warm booth, good for the soul.
record_store: Cardboard bins, handwritten price tags, a clerk who won't stop talking. Could be something good in here. Could just kill an hour.
